newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Mori and Aloisi given their chance in World Cup opener.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Mori and Aloisi given their chance in World Cup opener.

text.p: Terry Venables has given strikers Damian Mori and John Aloisi an opportunity to stake their claims for a permanant role when Australia begin their World Cup qualifying campaign on Wednesday.
Mori and Aloisi will lead the attack in the absence of injured veteran Graham Arnold and Mark Viduka against Solomon Islands in the Oceania qualifier at Parramatta Stadium.
Viduka is yet to return from club duty in Croatia.
Venables has relied almost exclusively on overseas-based players, with only midfielder Craig Foster and defender and captain Alex Tobin of the local contingent making the starting line-up.
The Oceania champions will face a final qualifier against an Asian opponent later this year, with the winner advancing to the finals in France next year.
Team - Mark Bosnich, Tony Vidmar, Steve Horvat, Alex Tobin (captain), Robbie Slater, Craig Foster, Ned Zelic, Stan Lazaridis, Aurelio Vidmar, John Aloisi, Damian Mori.
